0|f19397a5c65665d66e3866b42056f1f58b7a366b|torvalds~linux|/home/usuario01/Titan-Files-Research/src/_00/output/C/torvalds~linux|False|"bpf: Add access to snd_cwnd and others in sock_ops
Adds read access to snd_cwnd and srtt_us fields of tcp_sock. Since these
fields are only valid if the socket associated with the sock_ops program
call is a full socket
column2: the field is_fullsock is also added to the

column1: bpf_sock_ops struct. If the socket is not a full socket
fields returns 0.
Note that in most cases it will not be necessary to check is_fullsock to
know if there is a full socket. The context of the call
the 'op' field
column2: can sometimes determine whether there is a full socket.

column1: The struct bpf_sock_ops has the following fields added:
__u32 is_fullsock;      /* Some TCP fields are only valid if
* there is a full socket. If not
* fields read as zero.
__u32 snd_cwnd;
__u32 srtt_us;          /* Averaged RTT << 3 in usecs */
There is a new macro
column3: to make it easier to add

column1: read access to more 32 bit tcp_sock fields.
